summary: Hydro One Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its 2025 Statement of Executive Compensation as a stand-alone document under Canadian exemptive relief. The filing is a routine executive compensation disclosure, not a special situation event. No deals, restructurings, or corporate actions are involved. The registrant is the issuer filing a foreign private issuer report on Form 6-K, which is the US equivalent of a Canadian regulatory filing for compensation disclosure. This is a periodic, non-event-driven filing with no special situation implications.
